topics.title: About this expanded volume
topics.summary: This volume moves from parallel-computing fundamentals into CUDA C++, GPU memory behavior, asynchronous execution, profiling, signal processing, real-time design, and production heterogeneous systems. It uses the same operating discipline as the preceding volumes: establish a contract, trace the mechanism, implement a bounded change, verify correctness independently, measure the relevant performance quantity, and preserve a fallback path.

topics.title: How to use this book
topics.summary: Read each chapter in three passes. First identify the invariant and data path. Second trace the worked implementation and predict its failure modes before running it. Third run the lab on hardware you control, record compiler and device information, and compare observations with the stated acceptance criteria. Performance numbers in the text are examples of methodology, not promises for a particular GPU.
